title: kbpublic.file_hits calls a replacing leak_scan extender without the root, so an extender declared with root=None never gets the file's root
goal: kbpublic.file_hits passes the file's root to a replacing leak_scan extender that takes it, so an extender declared file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=(), root=None) gets the root the shipped scan gets

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kbpublic,inspect; sys.exit(0 if "scan(path, text, allow, pinned, root)" in inspect.getsource(kbpublic.file_hits) else "not yet: the extender call has no root")

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbpublic as k
seen=[]
def two(path,text,allow,pinned=(),root=None):
    seen.append(root);return []
def old(path,text,allow,pinned):
    seen.append('old');return []
k.replaced_scan=lambda:two
k.file_hits('a.md','x',{},(),'R')
k.replaced_scan=lambda:old
k.file_hits('a.md','x',{},(),'R')
print(seen);sys.exit(0 if seen==['R','old'] else 1)

clauses.clause: kbpublic.file_hits passes the file's root to a replacing leak_scan extender that takes it, so an extender declared file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=(), root=None) gets the root the shipped scan gets

notes: Premise run 2026-11-09: the repro fails on the base (kbpublic.py:634 calls scan(path, text, allow, pinned)). Outbound paths of file_hits (referrers, read 2026-11-09): kbpublic.tree_hits and bl_check.py:507, census.py:2939 and the extension point leak_scan (kbext.py:80, SURFACE signature file_hits(path, text, allow, pinned=(), root=None)) call the replaceable scan; publish and contribute pass shipped=True and never reach the extender, so the change is only the one call at kbpublic.py:634; an extender declared without root keeps working (the planted check runs both a root-taking and a four-argument extender).
